evidence.why_reconstructed: M3 recorded no command line anywhere. data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/m3/tokenize.log holds four `tokenize_text rc=0` lines and the tqdm output, and no document in the repository names the invocation. That absence is the defect this sidecar exists to stop recurring: from M3-R on, tools/text_stream_audit.py record-tokenize is run after each tokenize_text.py call, with provenance `recorded`.
evidence.how_the_flags_were_established: All 160 shipped tok-text .npz files reproduce byte for byte from tokenize_and_pad_text with no_whitespace_before_word=False, text_padding_id=3, end_of_text_padding_id=0 and audio_tokenizer_frame_rate=12.5 over the shipped word transcripts; 0 of 160 reproduce with the flag on. Those four values are therefore measured, not assumed. Only the two directory paths (read off the on-disk layout) and --text_tokenizer_repo (DATASET_SPEC.md:138 and reports/m3-tokenize-report.json) are inferred, and --num_workers is 1 because the log shows a single worker.
evidence.reproduce: uv run --no-sync --with sentencepiece --with numpy --with tqdm --with huggingface_hub python -m tools.text_stream_audit counterfactual --word_transcript_dir data/experiments/tsukuyomi_ojousama/m3/<dataset>/<split>/text --text_tokenizer_path <j-moshi-ext snapshot>/tokenizer_spm_32k_3.model

known_defect.effect: tokenize_text.py prefixes every pyopenjtalk word with a space, and SentencePiece emits each of those as a bare U+2581. 44.6% of speaker A's emitted text tokens and 46.6% of speaker B's carry no content, and the stream runs 2.3x longer than it needs to. Nothing downstream notices: the parquet is well formed and training starts.
known_defect.superseded_by: M3-R 第2段 2-1: re-tokenize with the flag and diff rows 1-16 byte for byte. The rebuilt dataset gets its own dataset_id, manifest and sidecar.
